items.title: Whistle: Speech to Text in 16.9 MB
items.summary: Whistle is a new speech-to-text application that compresses audio files to just 16.9 MB while maintaining high accuracy. This development is significant for developers looking to integrate efficient speech recognition capabilities into their applications without sacrificing performance.

items.title: AI-ready biological data: $1.8B global commitment
items.summary: A global initiative has announced a $1.8 billion commitment to make biological data more accessible for AI applications. This investment is crucial for researchers and developers in the AI field, as it will enhance the quality and availability of data for training models.

items.title: Step 5 Preview, a 1M-context MoE from StepFun, shows up on OpenRouter
items.summary: The latest preview of Step 5 from StepFun introduces a mixture of experts (MoE) model capable of handling 1 million contexts. This advancement is important for AI developers as it pushes the boundaries of context handling in natural language processing tasks.

items.title: Show HN: Free open source Adobe Lightroom alternative, completely local with AI
items.summary: A new open-source project offers a fully local alternative to Adobe Lightroom, utilizing AI for image processing. This is a game-changer for photographers and developers looking for cost-effective and privacy-focused solutions in image editing.

items.title: Why isn't the industry freaking out about DeepSeek 4.1 Flash?
items.summary: The blog discusses the implications of the DeepSeek 4.1 Flash technology and why it hasn't garnered more attention from the industry. Understanding these developments is essential for engineers and developers who need to stay ahead in the rapidly evolving tech landscape.
